The *Parihāna Sutta* (Iti 79; It 3.30, PTS It 71) is a short discourse in the *Tikanipāta* of the *Itivuttaka* [SuttaCentral]. The text expounds the three qualities or conditions that lead to the falling away or decline (*parihāna*) of a monk in training (*sekha*) [SuttaCentral]. Bhikkhu Sujato has translated the sutta into English under the title *Decline* [SuttaCentral]. None of the surveyed secondary literature passages discuss this specific *Itivuttaka* text, instead treating homonymous suttas in the *Saṁyutta Nikāya* and *Aṅguttara Nikāya* or examining the technical concept of spiritual regression (*parihāna*) across Abhidharma and Yogācāra materials.
